newsitem.title: UK: Ldn gold off highs as selling pressure emerges.
newsitem.headline: Ldn gold off highs as selling pressure emerges.

text.p: GOLD - Fixed higher at $342.80 from $339.65 on Friday. Market losing steam after NY-led highs on Monday when UK was closed for Bank holiday. Bre-X news not seen having impact in longer term.
SILVER - Quoted off highs at $4.75/$4.77. Following gold.
PLATINUM - Barely changed from New York's close at $373.50/$374.50. Forward market still tight.
PALLADIUM - Firmer at $158.50/$159.50. No word on Russia sales.
